title: Home practical guide and safety card: celery in coloured water
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 3 (Home practical guide and safety card: celery in coloured water (portal worksheet; adult cuts, cover the table))
intro: Lesson 3: How water moves through a plant. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see how water moves up through a plant
equipment: A stick of celery with leaves
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Half fill the glass with water and add a few drops of food colouring
An adult cuts the bottom off the celery
Stand the celery in the coloured water
Leave it for a day; look at the leaves every few hours
An adult cuts across the stalk: look for coloured dots (the xylem tubes)

questions.q: Water moves up a plant through the...
Big question: how does water reach the top of a tall tree?
questions.a: It travels up through tiny tubes in the trunk from the roots to the leaves.
